description: SYNTHETIC FIXTURE. Adversarial and benign corpus for validateExplanationProse (T-2006/T-2030). Every numeric field, food/exercise name and sentence here is synthetic test data, not a real client, plan or clinical claim. Cases that omit maxCharacters/minCharacters use the shared explanation budget (40-400 characters) defined by the test harness that loads this file.
